note: 12C Part 2: a let-dynamic-only mark is scoped to the INPUT UNIT that made it -- one FeEvaluateString/FeEvaluateFile call, i.e. one kg `load'. Fe's standalone driver is not an input unit: it reads and evaluates form by form, so `ctx->input_scope' is 0 throughout and every mark is visible, which is what this case pins and why the scoping itself cannot be exercised from this corpus (fe/test_api.c:TestOneArgDefvarScope is where it is). kg-policy: the marking primitive is fe's and Emacs has no host context to compare against.
